Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

cunning adjective

also shrewd, astute, sly, wily, crafty, tricky

classical

Plaut. Am. 1.1.112: malus, callidus, astūtus admodum (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 148, 149, 157, 158
Lewis & Short s.v. astūtus

astūtus, astūta, astūtum

Declension on Wiktionary

shrewd, crafty, sly

Other words

  • dolōsus, dolōsa, dolōsum — crafty, deceitful

    also used · classical · Plaut. Mil. 2.2.43 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 158, 159, 398, 407 · Declension on Wiktionary

    (Lewis & Short: rare, and mostly poetic)

  • subdolus, subdola, subdolum — sly, deceitful

    also used · classical · Plaut. Poen. 5.2.72 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 159, 407 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • colubrīnus, colubrīna, colubrīnum — snaky: cunning, wily

    also used · classical · Plaut. Truc. 4.3.6: ingeniō esse (Lewis & Short); Traupman 151; Traupman 299 · Declension on Wiktionary

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.; Lewis & Short: early and late Latin)

    Traupman prints collubrīnus; Lewis & Short has colubrīnus, from coluber, snake: “like a serpent; trop., cunning, wily (ante- and post-class.)”.

  • vafer, vafra, vafrum — sly, crafty, artful

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 3.57: versūtī potius, obscūrī, astūtī, fallācis, malitiōsī, callidī, veterātōris, vafrī (Lewis & Short); Traupman 407 · Declension on Wiktionary

See also clever, crooked.
